systems.country_label: application de la gestion des communications à travers la ligne d'appel d'urgence « 19 »
systems.tiers: Command and coordination rooms in 52 police centres nationally, generalised in 2021

systems.country_label: Applications informatiques pour la numérisation de la gestion et du stockage des documents de contrôle routier
systems.tiers: Extended in 2021 to Casablanca, Fès, Beni Mellal, Oujda, Settat, Agadir, Laâyoune, Meknès, Taza, Ouarzazate, Errachidia and Dakhla

systems.country_label: règlement électronique des amendes transactionnelles et forfaitaires

systems.tiers: 22 vehicles linked to the biometric databases, serving rural and isolated areas

systems.country_label: Laboratoire National de la Police Scientifique
systems.tiers: Casablanca, new premises opened 2021; central digital-traces laboratory and five regional laboratories
Online applications to police entrance examinations

note: The DGSN's 2021 review dates GESTARR's rollout (448 arrondissements; Dakhla, Laâyoune and Casablanca added in 2021, Oujda the last still to come) but calls it only an information system for managing the arrondissements and does not say that reports or cases are entered in it, so it is unclassified here and gives no fact.
